g.text: AgriLink — Full Technical Approach & System Architecture
AI-Orchestrated Farm-to-Consumer Supply Network with Blockchain Fair-Share Economics | Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026)
• Consumer crate scan reveals farm GPS
Clustered Persistence Tier: Supabase PostgreSQL + PostGIS Spatial Engine
• Relational schema: Users (RBAC), Farm Acreage, Grade Listings, Realtime Order State
• Spatial geofencing & distance decay matrices for hyper-local route optimization
Microeconomic Impact & Nash Equilibrium (SIH Pilot Metric)
• +35% to +48% Smallholder Farmer Realized Net Income via Direct Farm-Gate Escrow
• -18% to -24% Consumer Retail Price Reduction | <4% Post-Harvest Spoilage (vs 28%)
